messages:
Maya Chen: FYI I ran the new int8 candidate through the eval harness and saw ROUGE-L spike by ~7 pts vs float32, BLEU also up. Feels suspicious — probably tokenization/prefix handling.

Samir Patel: Can you paste the raw token lists? Did you run the same tokenizer & vocab across quantized build and reference?

Maya Chen: Here's quick repro:
```
# token compare
print(tokenizer.encode('The quick brown fox'))
# float32: [101, 1000, 2003, 234]
# int8-build: [101, 1000, 2003, 234, 0]
```
float32 run had no trailing pad; int8 build produced extra pad token at generate time.

Rachid: ugh, padding drift. Could be that the runtime's batcher is sending fixed-length tensors with `pad_token_id` appended before postproc. Any evidence in logs?

Eval-Bot: eval-run 2026-04-12T13:12Z finished. metrics: ROUGE-L=0.78, BLEU=0.42, BERTScore-F1=0.89, pass@1=0.34, pass@5=0.51

Maya Chen: Logs show the runtime using length=seq_len not trimmed after KV merge:
```
INFO runtime.batch: merged_seq_len=128, output_len=129
```
so last token becomes pad for some sequences.

Priya N.: Important: this will inflate ROUGE since extra pad tokens may match gold whitespace handling in evaluation script. Also affects exact-match for structured JSON outputs — trailing nulls cause mismatches or accidental matches depending on normalizer.

Samir Patel: Proposed fixes: (1) force trim outputs to eos_token before detokenize in runner; (2) update CI smoke to run token-level diff against baseline; (3) add a test asserting tokenizer+postproc parity across builds.

Maya Chen: Agree. I'll open a PR with a small patch to runner output postproc and add a unit test in eval-harness/tests/token_consistency_test.py

Rachid: Also flag the metric alerting: current dashboard SCC fired because ROUGE delta>0.05. We need a CI gate that ignores positive spikes if token mismatch suspected. Otherwise we get flaky "improvements" that aren't real.

Priya N.: Note on pass@k: sampling temperature changes with quantization can also change pass@k; we should compute CI-aware confidence intervals around pass@k using bootstrap in the harness. I'll sketch that.

Samir Patel: Thanks. @Maya @Priya file the run link and I'll coordinate with eng-runtime to patch the batching behavior. :thumbsup:

Infra-Bot: deploy patch scheduled, canary to eng-runtime-test tomorrow 02:00 UTC

Maya Chen: Link: https://internal.rw/eval/1932101123-run (contains token diffs and failing example)

Maya Chen: I'll update thread when PR lands.
